brandingHint: Only platform administrators can change platform configuration. Saving a deployment domain immediately updates public URLs such as the MCP endpoint and Executor startup commands. Without a domain, the deployment environment URL is used.
domainHint: Enter the URL users visit for this deployment, for example https://wonder.example.com. Saving it immediately updates public URLs such as the MCP endpoint and Executor startup commands.
logoTooLarge: Logo files must not exceed 512 KB
logoHint: Supports PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP, SVG, GIF, ICO and AVIF, up to 512 KB.
accentHint: The accent color applies to primary buttons, links, selections and focus indicators. Page backgrounds and success, warning and error colors stay the same.
primaryColorHint: Use the color control to choose a custom primary color. Click Save configuration to apply your changes.
imLoadFailed: Failed to load collaboration notification configuration
providerHint: Choose Feishu or DingTalk for the platform. Project notifications and personal IM identities follow this setting.
channelHint: After switching and saving, the previous channel stops sending notifications.
keepSecretHint: Leave blank to keep the configured AppSecret
keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the current secret
adminPermission: Only platform administrators can perform this action
adminHint: Platform administrators manage platform configuration, collaboration notifications and all Workspaces, including the recycle bin. Administrators cannot remove themselves, and at least one must remain.
searchHint: Search by name, username or email
selfRemoval: You cannot remove yourself as a platform administrator
lastAdmin: At least one platform administrator must remain
ssoHint: Maintain identity providers (IdPs) and login connections here. The login page only shows connections whose connection and parent IdP are both enabled, in creation order.
ssoDisableIdpImpact: {{connections}} login connections under this IdP will also be hidden from the login page. Their configuration is kept.
ssoConnectionHint: Each connection is one login entry and can be enabled or disabled independently. The protocol and parent IdP cannot be changed after creation.
ssoProtocolLockedHint: The IdP and protocol cannot be changed after creation.
ssoSamlCallbackHint: Configure this ACS URL as the assertion consumer service on the IdP, and make the IdP return RelayState unchanged.
ssoOidcCallbackHint: Configure this URL as the redirect URI of the OIDC application.
ssoCallbackDeployHint: The URL uses the configured deployment domain, falling back to the platform public address or the current origin. Update the IdP configuration after changing the domain.
ssoClientSecretKeepHint: A secret is configured. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
ssoClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
ssoAttributeHint: Optional. Protocol defaults are used when left blank.
ssoAllowedTenantsHint: Optional. Separate multiple values with commas; leave blank for no restriction.
ssoNewConnectionDisabledHint: New connections start disabled. Enable one after confirming its configuration.
ssoLoadFailed: Failed to load enterprise SSO configuration
ssoPreviewHint: These are the login methods currently shown on the login page, in creation order.
ssoPreviewEmpty: No login methods to show. Enable a connection and its parent IdP.
ssoPreviewOnly: This is a preview only. Start signing in from the login page.
ssoOverviewHint: SSO sign-in methods are maintained by platform administrators. You can view this overview only and cannot change the configuration.
